entities.summary: Cuban Revolution, a transformative movement in Cuba (1892–1898). Emerged from General Weyler's reconcentration camps cause mass civilian deaths and Pact of Zanjón ends the Ten Years' War 1878. Catalyzed Weyler and Cuban Republic inaugurated — May 20, 1902.
